# IBombRules.Push property

How fast its explosion sends a runner away from it, whatever the distance, on top of half the runner's velocity: by default the run speed of the movement rules ([`RunSpeed`](../../ModRunners.Api.Runners/IRunningRules/RunSpeed.md)), 600. Below 0, it pulls runners toward it.

public float Push { get; set; }
